violation_type.title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact EMS (26 TAC §747.3405(b)(1))
violation_type.short_title: Child Becomes Ill in Care and Requires Immediate Treatment or Hospitalization - Contact EMS
violation_type.typical_finding: A child experienced a brief febrile seizure while in care and did not promptly return to their normal level of responsiveness.  Emergency personnel were contacted 13 minutes after the incident occurred.
